title: Autumn Layers, Two Ways
description: Two distinctly autumnal directions united by warm brown tones: the left pairs a brown herringbone belted blazer with a black button-down shirt, mocha leggings, and black knee-high block-heel boots alongside a distressed brown leather tote — refined and office-ready; the right pivots softer with a blush ribbed V-neck sweater over a tweed bow-tie mini skirt, cream ribbed socks, and tan knee-high boots with a camel drawstring tote — a feminine academic look. Gold jewelry and leather gloves bridge both directions.
occasion: weekend outing, casual office, autumn city walk
